title: Letter collection
description: A sealed coastal envelope opens into a spread of photographs.
useCase: Turn opening a small curated collection into a deliberate reveal.
interaction: Open the envelope and browse the photographs.
reducedMotion: The flap and photographs change pose immediately.
limitations: Three sample photographs; the envelope and spread are authored transforms rather than paper collision simulation.
look: Flat cream paper envelope with a round dark green seal and soft shadow, centred on a dusty blue-grey field above a small letterspaced caption.
motion: Opening flips the flap back in 3D, shrinks the envelope and fans three tilted photographs up and out over 420 ms ease-out; selecting a photo opens it full-frame.
adapt: Poses are CSS: `.lc-flap` turns to `rotateX(180deg)` under `perspective:800px`, `.lc-envelope` scales to `.55`, and each `.lc-photo` gets an inline fan `transform` (`[-9, 3, 10]` degrees), eased by `420ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`. Replace `views` with your images.
